project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-142 Wave 5 (Cut List: WS-Z dead routes + WS-AA DROP prep)
description: Delete-only wave, under green. Phase 0 verdicts + method caveats live in docs/PRDS/PRD-142-WAVE5-PHASE0-VERDICTS.md (read it first, every iteration). WS-W/WS-X already executed on feat/prd142-wave5-cuts (neural_field+AEM, workflow bridge, mcp_executor, seed v2, chatbot_llm shim — all cut, greps zero). This loop covers WS-Z (route clusters: per-route verify-then-cut) and WS-AA prep (reversible DROP migrations, NEVER applied by the loop). Contract per cut: segment-level grep proves zero inbound on live code + flag-gate check + external-caller check + scheduler check; then unmount + delete + orphan cleanup; orchestrator-tests green; cut-grep zero. ZERO live functionality removed; survivors are not refactored.

userStories.description: 18 routes with zero refs (re-mine 2026-06-09). Verify each per the contract (segment greps incl. template-literal forms, flag gates, dashboards), then cut the dead routes and any service code orphaned by them.
acceptanceCriteria: Per-route verdict table (kill/keep + evidence) recorded in the commit message or plan file
Verified-dead routes unmounted + deleted; orphaned imports/services removed

userStories.title: Cut the heartbeat.py dead cluster — scheduler-aware
userStories.description: 12 routes with zero HTTP refs, BUT heartbeat may be driven by internal schedulers/cron (PRD-141 era), not HTTP consumers. Check scheduler registrations and config-driven invocation before declaring any route dead. If the subsystem is live-but-internal, record KEEP and exit the story.
acceptanceCriteria: Scheduler/cron/config invocation check recorded per route
Only routes with zero HTTP AND zero scheduler callers are cut
orchestrator-tests green; cut-greps zero

userStories.title: Sweep the remaining candidates, batched by router file
userStories.description: Work the rest of the 290-candidate list router-by-router (batches ≤10 routes). Skip KEEP-external (widgets/*, voice audio, webhooks, OAuth callbacks). A route referenced only by tests: cut route + test together. Anything ambiguous after the checks: flag RALPH_BLOCKED-style in the plan for Gerard rather than guessing.

All verified-dead routes cut with orphan cleanup; ambiguous ones listed for Gerard
